summary: Crescent Energy Company filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing credit agreement. The Fifteenth Amendment decreased the borrowing base from $3.9 billion to $3.5 billion per the April 2026 scheduled redetermination, extended the revolving loan maturity to May 2031 from October 2030, and allowed up to $600 million of additional indebtedness without a borrowing base reduction through October 2026. This is a routine credit facility amendment and does not represent a special situation event.
